address: 39-1 Zishan Street, Haizhu, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: Though Zijin occupies two adjoining ground-floor units, there is barely an empty seat throughout the day. For over 10 years, locals have been fans of the impeccable barbecue meats, which are displayed in all their glory at the front of the shop. The signature goose braised in premium soy boasts velvety meat and deep flavours. Double-boiled soups, stir-fries and claypot dishes are also popular. Come early, as certain items tend to run out....
